title: Structured learning journey and safe progress synchronization
summary: Replace the home screen with a real-progress journey dashboard, add course selection and optional placement, and connect local progress to the revision-checked cloud API.

changes.detail: Typed roadmap, module prerequisites, optional diagnostics with no completion credit, and additive journey migration.
Home presents the active course, actual completion, saved lesson stage, weekly goal and review evidence; onboarding leads to course selection.
Automatic authenticated snapshot synchronization uses revision checks and a conservative three-way merge; conflicts preserve local work.

validation.name: Catalog audit
validation.detail: 125 modules, 1460 indexed entries; no duplicate lesson IDs or missing module references across ten courses.

validation.name: Typecheck and functional verification
validation.detail: Validation in progress. Physical Android, authenticated multi-device runtime, comprehensive historical lesson quality and production deployment are not verified.
